name: The St. Regis Resort Bora Bora
insider_take: The St. Regis Bora Bora isn't just a resort—it's your gateway to French Polynesia's most legendary island, where overwater villas perch above crystalline lagoons and Mount Otemanu creates a dramatic volcanic backdrop.
whats_special: This is the largest overwater villa resort in the South Pacific, featuring 77 overwater villas with glass floor panels for lagoon viewing. The resort sits on a private motu (coral islet) with direct views of Bora Bora's extinct volcanic peak, Mount Otemanu. Each villa comes with a signature St. Regis Butler service and private beach access.
pro_tip: Book a villa on the sunset side for unobstructed views of Mount Otemanu and the main island. The lagoon here is deeper, making it perfect for swimming and spotting tropical fish right from your deck.
dont_miss: The resort's signature Lagoon Restaurant by Jean-Georges Vongerichten, built entirely over the water. Take advantage of the complimentary snorkeling gear to explore the coral gardens, or book the private beach picnic on a secluded motu. The sunset ceremony with Polynesian drums happens daily at the beach bar.
pros: Iconic overwater villas with direct lagoon access and glass floor panels
Legendary St. Regis butler service providing personalized attention
Breathtaking views of Mount Otemanu and pristine turquoise lagoon
World-class spa treatments in an authentic Polynesian setting
cons: Remote French Polynesian location requires extensive travel time
